{{Quote|One of the droid control programs has been stolen by the pitiful Naboo.|Viceroy Nute Gunray|audio=ProgramTheft.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Force Command Two''' was a unit in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], loyal to the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]. Shortly after the company's landing, three [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of Force Command Two fought two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and stole one of five [[droid control program]]s that had been sent to Naboo to keep the Federation [[Army/Legends|army]] active. The program was taken to a research station near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harte Secur]], where it was used to deactivate a portion of the Droid Army [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[OOM-14/Legends|OOM-14]]. [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] to recover the program, an objective he soon [[Capture of Harte Secur|completed]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|FORCE COMMAND TWO<br />STATUS: CAPTURE NOW|Transliteration of Aurebesh text identifying Force Command Two|<ref name="GB" />}}
The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] theft of the droid control program was first mentioned in the [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]]<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> for the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. In the game, the perpetrators were identifed as Force Command Two via [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text in the cutscene of the second level of the Trade Federation campaign, entitled "Behind the lines."<ref name="GB" />
